alignments.note: כִּי rendered *For*.
The ASV writes a bare *the* for this article (rule 15).
Participle rendered by the agent noun *seller*.
Preposition rendered *to*.
Substantival article takes the supplied *that which* and heads on the pronoun rather than the relative (rule 41).
The predicate word keeps its own English together with the supplied copula (rule 41).
Negative takes its own *not*.
Finite verb with auxiliary, discontinuous around the negative.
The waw is rendered by the concessive connective *although*, which is the word the ASV wrote for it (rule 14's open list).
Adverb rendered *yet*.
The ASV recasts *among the living* as the bare predicate adjective *alive*, leaving the preposition no English word (rule 40).
Article assimilated into the pointed preposition; the ASV writes no *the* for it (rules 12 and 29).
The predicate word takes the construction-supplied copula under rule 20, headed on the lexeme-bearing *alive*; discontinuous around *yet* (rule 25).
The ASV's recasting collapses *their life* into the subject pronoun, so the noun itself receives no English word; the note at this verse records the literal Hebrew.
The suffix takes the subject pronoun the recasting leaves for it; rule 40 states that the English realizing a suffix need not be possessive or object.
כִּי rendered *for*.
No article morpheme is present, so the supplied *the* belongs to the nominal expression it determines (rule 15).
Prepositional predicate carrying the supplied copula (rule 49), headed on the word carrying the relation.
Quantifier rendered *whole*.
Construct noun with a supplied *the* (rule 29), discontinuous around *whole*.
Suffix takes *thereof*.
The negative is what the ASV's *none* renders here; the margin's *it shall not turn back* is an alternative rendering only.
Finite verb with auxiliary.
Waw plus the clause's negative fused into *neither*; rule 35 allows the fusion across the intervening material.
אִישׁ rendered by the indefinite *any*.
Preposition rendered *in*.
Construct noun taking a supplied *the*, since no article morpheme is present (rule 29).

The ASV recasts *in his iniquity, his life* as *in the iniquity of his life*, writing no pronoun for this suffix; the competing reading gives it the supplied *the*, but rule 29 already places that word on the construct noun.
Nomen rectum of the recast chain, taking the relational *of* (rule 19).
Suffix takes the possessive *his*.
Hithpael rendered *strengthen himself*; the reflexive pronoun realizes the verb's own voice and stays in its unit (rule 44). Discontinuous around *any* (rule 25).

review_notes: The concessive clause is heavily recast; the preposition, its article and the noun חַיָּת are left unrepresented under rule 40, while the suffix takes the subject pronoun *they*.
The second *neither* is a waw-plus-negative fusion spanning the fronted subject and prepositional phrase, which rule 35 explicitly permits.
